lines.5: 「Ahaha! Those glasses make Coconut look smart.」
lines.6: 「...Tch. This is why I hate idiots.」
lines.7: 「Hehehe, so you were a glasses girl all along. --I see, I see. Now this is interesting.」
lines.8: 「You even came with that character trait? Ooh, I want to keep you as a pet--with cat ears!」
lines.10: 「She gets strange sometimes. Just think of it as one of her fits and ignore her. She's missing a few of the screws a human being needs.」
